title: Deductible Options and Water Backup Limits: CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy
content:
**Which deductibles can a CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy carry?** Three per tier:

| Tier | Deductibles offered (USD) |
|---|---|
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential | 500, 1000, 2500 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Enhanced | 500, 1000, 2500 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Essential | 500, 1000, 2500 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced | 500, 1000, 2500 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier | 1000, 2500, 5000 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature | 1000, 2500, 5000 |

A deductible of 5000 USD exists only on CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier and CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature; a deductible of 500 USD exists only on the other four tiers.

**How much water backup coverage comes with each tier, and how far can it go?** The included limit comes in the package; an included limit of 0 means no water backup is included. More may be purchased above the included limit up to the highest total, at an annual premium for each 5,000 USD purchased above the included limit.

| Tier | Included water backup (USD) | Highest total water backup (USD) | Annual premium per 5,000 USD purchased (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential | 0 | 10000 | 42.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Enhanced | 5000 | 25000 | 40.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Essential | 5000 | 25000 | 40.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced | 10000 | 25000 | 38.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Premier | 15000 | 50000 | 36.00 |
| CondoGuard HO-6 Special Signature | 25000 | 50000 | 34.00 |

**A worked case (hypothetical).** A CondoGuard HO-6 Named Perils Essential policy has no water backup included. Purchasing a total of 10000 USD is two lots of 5,000 USD at 42.00 USD each, an annual premium of 84.00 USD, and 10000 USD is also that tier's highest total. On CondoGuard HO-6 Special Enhanced the first 10000 USD is included, so a total of 20000 USD means 10000 USD purchased, two lots at 38.00 USD, 76.00 USD a year.
